requirements.sourceQuote: Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business Studies (or in a related subject with a focus on Business Studies)
Evidence of having completed undergraduate courses in Strategic Management, Accounting and Controlling, and Operations Management (or equivalent topics), together worth at least 15 credit points

Minimum of 210 ECTS credit points – applicants with 180 ECTS will be required to obtain an additional 30 credits, for example, in an integrated internship after the first two semesters and before the end of their studies.
English language skills at least B2 level or higher
